title: Moving-average time-series line
intent: Smooth three weekly time series with a trailing seven-observation mean while preserving their original tidy data model.

ai.create: Create a responsive three-series UTC line chart from typed {id, date, value, series} rows using a strict trailing seven-observation moving average and no casts.
ai.maintain: Change the rolling window and alignment while preserving series isolation, stable keys, explicit domains, and the same tidy source rows.
